rubric.role_summary: iOS engineer leading development of native sponsorship experiences for creators and audiences, contributing to product direction and providing code review, mentorship, and technical architecture.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
iOS engineer leading development of native sponsorship experiences for creators and audiences, contributing to product direction and providing code review, mentorship, and technical architecture.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- At least 3+ years of software engineering experience.
- Experience shipping native iOS apps to the App Store.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience with both SwiftUI and UIKit.
- Experience at a fast-growing startup or working on a high-performing growth team.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): New York metropolitan area; San Francisco Bay Area, California. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
